environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) running as a Step Functions activity worker behind API Gateway WebSocket API. The Lambda execution role has AmazonStepFunctionsFullAccess and the function runs with default Lambda security context. No origin restrictions on the API Gateway stage. Session files stored in /tmp with default Lambda filesystem permissions. No request validation template on the WebSocket route.

config.api_gateway: WebSocket API, no route request validation
